Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Chronic (more than three months) ESBL colonization of the same strain as determined by
  -  species, [OR]  phenotype  [OR] and antibiogram

right.raw_text: -  Patients must be able to swallow sachets

left.raw_text: -  Must be able to speak and understand Swedish
-  Must have a permanent residence in Sweden

right.raw_text: -  Must be able to sign informed consent in Swedish

-  immunodeficiency
  -  psychiatric disorder
  -  alcohol  [OR] or substance abuse
  -  dementia
  -  Invasive catheters
